W: 4     A: 4   Ld: 7   Sv: 6+

[89AAFF]Wargear[-]: 
Power Klaw, 'Urty Syringe, Stikkbombs

'Urty Syringe
Rng: Melee    Type: Melee
S: User   AP: 0   D: 1
Ability: Can make 1 additional attack with this weapon. Wounds anything on 4+, except for Vehicle or Titanic units. Those are always wounded on 6+.

[89AAFF]Special Rules[-]: 'Ere We Go, Mob Rules, DAKKA DAKKA DAKKA!, Dok's Tools, Grot Orderly, Sawbonez

Dok's Tools:
Gives Infantry and Bikers within 3" 6+++.

Grot Orderly:
Can re-roll Sawbonez, either to see if it heals or the amount of Wounds regained. Only useable once.

Sawbonez:
Can heal a Biker or Infantry on a D6 of 2+. If failed, he deals a MW instead, but otherwise heals the model D3 wounds.
